content.comment_body: Hello, I'm encountering an issue where there is only one user called "Web user," but I'm unable to connect to the server with this user from two different browsers or PCs. Is access restricted to just a single connection? Thank you.

From what I know, the web server is designed to handle just one connection and that's the only configuration that has been tested officially by [company_name]. If you need a formal confirmation, it's best to submit a Support Request to [company_name].

Hi, [product_name] Web-Server actually supports up to four connections. Modern browsers often use multiple simultaneous connections. You might want to try using Firefox, the only browser I'm aware of that lets you manually restrict the number of concurrent connections to one. This setting needs to be adjusted on each device. In Firefox, open Options and navigate to Performance, where you can limit the number of connections it uses: [IMAGE] Hope this helps.
Where did you get that information? Can you specify the source?

Hi, I received this information at a trade show from a [company_name] representative and also found this article: [url] Additionally, I tested it using Firefox with the connection set to only one. I was able to open four successful instances connecting to the [product_name] Web-server, but the fifth attempt was unsuccessful.
I am specifically referring to your statement: '[product_name] Web-Server supports 4 connections.'
As far as I know, only a single connection has been tested and released for the [product_name] Webserver. However, if four connections work for you, that's fortunate.

Hi, The information about supporting four simultaneous connections was previously shared with me by a [company_name] representative at an event. I tested it as described using Firefox on a PC. I'm not certain whether browsers on Android devices allow this kind of connection restriction. Hope this clarifies things.
And does the official [company_name] support account not have information about this? That's quite odd.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are unclear about how many concurrent connections the [product_name] Web-Server supports. Due to limited official resources, users report conflicting results and uncertainty when trying to connect with multiple browsers or devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to connect to the [product_name] Web-Server using the same account from multiple devices or browsers, or at least to receive definitive, official guidance on the actual connection limit.
